what: Edit images with HiDream E1.1—superior image quality and editing accuracy compared to HiDream-E1-Full.
dossier:
1.  HiDream-O1-Image (8B):
    -   Architecture: Pixel-level Unified Transformer (UiT).
    -   Use Case: General text-to-image, editing, personalization, and long-text rendering.
    -   Advantage: End-to-end model; does not require external VAEs or disjoint text encoders [MODEL.md].
    -   Variants:
        -   HiDream-O1-Image (bf16): Undistilled, 50 inference steps [MODEL.md].
        -   HiDream-O1-Image-Dev (fp8): Distilled, 28 inference steps, optimized for faster inference [MODEL.md].
    -   Recommendation: For editing tasks, the README recommends using the full model [SOURCES.md]. 2.  HiDream-I1 (17B):
    -   Architecture: Sparse Diffusion Transformer.
    -   Use Case: Text-to-i
